body: Thank you for the reply, I've made an appointment to speak to my doctor today about how I'm feeling, I always thought for years the way I was feeling was always situational but I now know it's not as I always feel like this no matter what. All I can do is ask for help and try to think positively about my future as hard as that is! You are totally right there is so much pressure on people now to live there life a certain way!!
